name: Improved Furious Anger (Gestalt)
body:
Your fury has grown to allow you special powers while you rage.

Prerequisite: Con 15, Furious Anger, character level 5th.

Benefit: You gain a rage power. Treat your barbarian level as equal to your character level – 2 for the purposes of meeting prerequisites for rage powers and for using that power. In addition, you can rage an additional number of rounds per day equal to 1 round per two character levels.

Special: You count as having the barbarian rage powers class feature for the purposes of qualifying for feats (such as Extra Rage Power), but you still treat your barbarian level as equal to your character level – 2. If you gain levels in a class that grants the rage class feature, you can immediately trade this feat for the Extra Rage Power feat.
